svg.title: AkôFlow control-plane architecture
svg.desc: Desktop and API clients connect to the AkôFlow daemon. The daemon contains workflow control, planning, execution, and a scientific SQLite record, and connects to runtime adapters.
svg.text: Workflow planning, runtime orchestration, and scientific evidence in one local service.
Visual control of workflows, plans, runs, and evidence.
HTTP API · application services · persistent event loop
SQLite · workflow versions · plans · runs · transfers · provenance · audit
